title: fix(app-shell,plugin-detail): titles and links that name a list of records read the plural label (objectui#11733)
body:
Fixes #11733

Clause-②: no

## What changed

PR objectui#11728 (objectui#11696) gave `useObjectLabel()` an `objectPluralLabel(objectDef)` resolver (the translated plural, else the declared `pluralLabel`, else the singular) and used it for the object list page title, the `/data` title and the object breadcrumb. Every other place that names a LIST of an object's records now reads it too. Record-scoped text keeps `objectLabel`.

| Card location | Producer | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Related-list section titles | `RecordDetailView`, the single-relationship title | `objectPluralLabel` over the child object ("Tasks") |
| 1. Related-list section titles | `deriveRelatedLists`, the title it composes when a child points at the parent through more than one field | new `listLabel` option; `RecordDetailView` passes `objectPluralLabel`, so the title reads "Opportunities · Partner Project". It was built from the child's raw, untranslated label before |
| 1. Renderer fallback | `record:related_list` with no `title` (`record-related-list.tsx`) | the bundle's `objects.NAME.pluralLabel`, else the translated label, else the humanized name |
| same family | `record:reference_rail` entries with no `title`: each card title and the "+ N empty (…)" line (`record-reference-rail.tsx`) | the same as the row above |
| 2. Record form page breadcrumb link | `RecordFormPage` | the shared `label` is split: the link reads `listLabel` (plural); the "Create …" / "Edit …" title and the save toast keep `label` (singular) |
| 3. Favorites | `ObjectView`'s star button | the saved favorite's `label` is the plural |
| 3. Recent items | `useRecentItemLabel`, `object` kind | calls `objectPluralLabel` at the call site; `useNavTargetLabel` is not touched |
| 4. Record back-link fallback | `ObjectView`, both builders (the list schema's `onNavigate` and the record-link bridge's `openRecord`) | `viewOriginLabel(…) \|\| objectPluralLabel(objectDef)` |
| 4. Record back-link fallback | `AppContent`, a create that lands on the new record's page | the handed-over `originLabel` is the plural |

## Where it landed beyond the claim's file surface, and why

The claim named `RecordDetailView`, `record-related-list.tsx`, `RecordFormPage`, `ObjectView` and the recent-item label. Three more files, each the producer of a surface the card's acceptance covers:

- `packages/app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts`: it produces the multi-relationship related-list title (card location 1). Left alone, the record page would read "Tasks" next to "Opportunity · Partner Project". The new option is internal: `deriveRelatedLists` is not re-exported from app-shell's package entry (`exports` is `.` only, and `src/index.ts` names no `deriveRelatedLists`), so nothing published widens.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`: the second producer of the record page's `location.state.from.label` (card location 4), on the create path. The enumeration pin covers it.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-reference-rail.tsx`: two `objectLabel(` hits under the enumeration pin's `packages/plugin-detail/src`, and both name lists.

`Clause-②: no` still holds: no new export and no new locale key. `plugin-detail` reaches `objectPluralLabel` through the hook it already calls (`useSafeFieldLabel()` returns `useObjectLabel()`). `record-related-list.tsx` narrows with `'objectPluralLabel' in i18n` instead of the `as any` cast its singular read used.

## The nav entry, unchanged by ruling

`useNavTargetLabel`'s `object` rung still calls `objectLabel`, per step 3 of the spec's nav-label rule, as the seat ruled on objectui#11696. The recent-item `object` kind no longer asks it, and calls `objectPluralLabel` itself. The recent-item pin's last case asserts that `useNavTargetLabel` still answers "Project" / "项目" for the same object.

## Enumeration pin

`git grep -n 'objectLabel(' -- packages/app-shell/src packages/plugin-detail/src`, tests excluded, at head `50e8f98`: 12 hits (20 at base `17acfbb`), 0 of them in `plugin-detail`. `apps/console/src` has 0. Each remaining hit:

| File | Symbol | Classification |
|---|---|---|
| `AppContent.tsx` | `handleCrudSuccess`'s `label` (save toasts `form.updateSuccess` / `form.createSuccess`) | record-scoped: the toast for the one saved record |
| `AppContent.tsx` | the child-task branch of `handleRecordFormSuccess` (the same toasts) | record-scoped |
| `AppContent.tsx` | the global record-form modal's `title` (`form.editTitle` / `form.createTitle`), 2 hits | record-scoped: "Edit …" / "Create …" |
| `useNavTargetLabel.ts` | `case 'object'` | the nav-entry inheritance (spec step 3), unchanged by the seat's ruling on objectui#11696 |
| `ObjectDataPage.tsx` | `NavigationOverlay` `title` | record-scoped: the record drawer title |
| `ObjectView.tsx` | `useObjectActions({ objectLabel })` | record-scoped: the delete confirmation and toasts. The label is attributive to "record(s)": "Delete 3 Project records?", "Project deleted successfully" |
| `ObjectView.tsx` | the `ImportWizard` `objectLabel` prop | an object-kind action phrase, the "New …" class: the "Import {{object}}" title and the template file name. Kept singular, as PR objectui#11728's contract review classified it. It is a one-line change if the seat reads it as naming a list |
| `ObjectView.tsx` | two `NavigationOverlay` `title`s | record-scoped: the record drawer title |
| `RecordDetailView.tsx` | `recordDelete.confirmCopy({ label })` in the header's delete action | record-scoped: names the one record |
| `RecordFormPage.tsx` | `const label` | record-scoped: it now feeds only the title and the save toast |

## Tests

Seven pins, each named after this issue. In every `zh-CN` fixture `pluralLabel` is a different word from `label` (`项目` / `项目清单`), so an assertion can tell which key was read. Each has a no-plural control.

- `ObjectView.listLinksPlural-11733.test.tsx`: a real `ObjectView` in a real i18next instance (the 11696 harness). It reads the favorite the star button saves, and the way-back label each builder hands the record route (a list probe calls `schema.onNavigate` and the bridge's `openRecord`). The fixture's list view has no label, which is when the fallback applies.
- `RecordFormPage.listLinkPlural-11733.test.tsx`: the link reads the plural; the title and toast read the singular. Cells: en create, en edit, zh-CN, control.
- `RecordDetailView.relatedListTitlePlural-11733.test.tsx`: single- and multi-relationship titles, en and zh-CN, control.
- `useRecentItemLabel.objectPlural-11733.test.tsx`: en, zh-CN, control, the machine-name floor, and the unchanged nav-entry inheritance.
- `AppContent.createLandingOriginPlural-11733.test.tsx`: the `AppContent.declaredVisibilityKeys` harness with a real i18next instance. The modal's `onSuccess` is called with a saved id for a page-surface object, and the record route's probe shows the state it received. The save runs outside `act`: an awaited React 19 `act` there did not return before the test timeout.
- `record-related-list.titlePlural-11733.test.tsx` and `record-reference-rail.titlePlural-11733.test.tsx`: plurals from the bundle only (these renderers hold the object's name, not its definition), en and zh-CN, with controls.

## Reverse verification (on `a46d4a9`, the implementation commit)

Mutations went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each anchor's declared hit count was met and each file's blob changed. A script-held trap restored every path, proven by each blob equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The direction was written down before each run.

- **Leg A**: every list-naming site back to the singular (11 anchors in 8 files). Predicted 19 red and 12 green. Observed `Tests 19 failed | 12 passed (31)`. The failures read `expected 'Project' to be 'Projects'`, `expected '项目' to be '项目清单'`, and the form link `'Project'` / `'项目'`. Every control stayed green.
- **Leg B**: only `deriveRelatedLists` back to the raw label. Predicted 2 red and 1 green on the RecordDetailView pin. Observed `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`: "Unable to find an element with the text: Opportunities · Primary Project" and the same for "商机列表 · Primary Project".

`50e8f98` changes only the types of the AppContent pin's modal probe.

The selection is `git grep -l` over app-shell's test files for RecordDetailView, RecordFormPage, ObjectView, AppContent, useRecentItemLabel, deriveRelatedLists, useNavTargetLabel, RecentApps, HomeRail, CommandPalette, UnifiedSidebar, StudioHomePage, useFavorites, FavoritesProvider and the related-list / reference-rail blocks. The other files are left to CI's full `pnpm test`. Blind spot: a test that renders these modules through a component whose name matches none of those words. The narrowed runs are on `a46d4a9`; `50e8f98` changes one pin's types only, and that pin re-ran on `50e8f98`.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed; no carrier)

- A favorite saved before this change keeps the label it was stored with. Favorites store their text, and object favorites have no refresh path (`refreshLabel` is called for record favorites only). Starring again saves the plural. Read from source, not measured.
- `record:related_list` and `record:reference_rail` never read the related object's declared `label` or `pluralLabel`, because they hold its name only. Their fallback was bundle-then-humanized before and stays that way. With no bundle entry, an object with a declared plural is still headed by its humanized name there.
- The relationship-field half of the multi-relationship title ("· Partner Project") is the field's authored `label`, untranslated, as before.
- `ImportWizard` keeps the singular (see the enumeration table).
